---
id: get-staffing-gap
title: "Get the staffing gap for a path within a committed shift plan"
description: "Read-model projection: plannedHeads (from the committed ShiftPlan for siteCode+shiftId) vs. currently active LaborAssignment count for pathId. Raises PathUnderstaffed when active assignments fall short of plannedHeads. This surfaces the gap only — it never decides or performs a rebalance; that stays a human call recorded via POST /associates/{id}/assignments. ShiftPlan is keyed by site+shift, so both are needed as query parameters alongside the path in the URL — a path's planned heads only make sense within one committed plan. `siteCode` is the canonical name (ADR 0035): it is the plan lookup key AND the associate scope (activeHeads counts only associates with an active shift at that site, ADR 0034). `buildingId` is the DEPRECATED alias for the plan lookup ONLY: a call that gives just buildingId is NOT scoped by site and counts fleet-wide, exactly as before. One of the two is required (neither is 400 missing-building-id). When both are given, buildingId is the plan key and siteCode the scope, as ADR 0034 defined."

Read-model projection: plannedHeads (from the committed ShiftPlan for siteCode+shiftId) vs. currently active LaborAssignment count for pathId. Raises PathUnderstaffed when active assignments fall short of plannedHeads. This surfaces the gap only — it never decides or performs a rebalance; that stays a human call recorded via POST /associates/\{id\}/assignments. ShiftPlan is keyed by site+shift, so both are needed as query parameters alongside the path in the URL — a path's planned heads only make sense within one committed plan. `siteCode` is the canonical name (ADR 0035): it is the plan lookup key AND the associate scope (activeHeads counts only associates with an active shift at that site, ADR 0034). `buildingId` is the DEPRECATED alias for the plan lookup ONLY: a call that gives just buildingId is NOT scoped by site and counts fleet-wide, exactly as before. One of the two is required (neither is 400 missing-building-id). When both are given, buildingId is the plan key and siteCode the scope, as ADR 0034 defined.
